digest.component_or_area: Git repository reclamation helper (ref-hygiene backup preparation)
propositions: Prepare an off-repository backup bundle and manifest of origin/tickets with full history before reclamation, without performing any remote ref deletion or push operations
Enumerate live origin heads and tags at runtime, collapse annotated-tag peeled refs, and record exact old-tip ancestry relationships for each commit ref
Refuse partial/promisor clones, pre-existing reclaim-backup refs, and output paths inside the repository or registered worktrees; create owned temporary namespace for each invocation
Build and verify the bundle from explicit temporary refs, then restore into a throwaway clone to confirm exact OID mapping and bundle integrity
Record manifest with canonical refs, direct/peeled OIDs, and one ancestry classification per commit; snapshot origin heads/tags before and after to prove no remote mutation occurred
